prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: low-resolution medieval RPG dialogue portrait candidate.
Primary request: Draw one completely new close-up pixel portrait, using reference 1 for the character's identity and clothes ONLY. References 2-5 (Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore) are the hard style and framing targets, not alternative identities. This is a substantive redraw, not a crop/filter of reference 1.
Style: coarse hand-clustered square-pixel aesthetic of the four close-up references, large simple cheekbone and nose planes, hard stepped contours, extremely restrained face marks. Muted earth palette, at most 32 intended opaque working colors. Do not dither, stipple, anti-alias, softly shade, add gradients, fine illustration texture, hair strand hatching or glossy details.
Composition: vertical 74:100 aspect. One large head fills most of the image; only a very short neck and a narrow strip of period collar at the bottom, no chest or shoulder-width bust. Entire hair, hat if specified, side hair and ears must fit comfortably inside the canvas with REAL transparent safety space of at least 2 logical pixels at the top and both sides. No silhouette may touch an edge. Portrait faces gently toward the viewer's left, both eyes remain readable.
Eyes: tiny deep-set dark pixel eyes below natural brows; only a tiny dull warm-gray sclera fleck if needed, never bright white eyeballs, never anime eyes. Face anatomy must read via broad angular cheekbone planes and a substantial nose with a stepped bridge and tip. Short coherent shadow blocks, not scattered pixels.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no checkerboard painted into the image, no solid background, no frame, no text, no labels. Exactly one person, no props, no hands, no effects. This is a portrait, not a character sheet.
Subject: Reha (雷哈), SKO-S02-NPC, male father of a returned adult captive, in his FIFTIES, clearly older than the charcoal keeper but not a frail 70-year-old. Preserve reference 1's full swept-back silver-gray wavy hair silhouette with its center off-part and complete side wisps, prominent ear, medium-length angular nose and compact silver-gray beard/moustache. Warm pale-tan weathered skin, clear angular cheekbones and modest under-eye/outer-eye age planes, no deep old-man furrows. The swept silver hair is grouped into four to six large dark/light clusters, not dozens of bright thin stripes.
Expression: quietly attentive, slow-spoken and thinking, gaze turned slightly toward a doorway; plain level brows with a small asymmetry and a firmly resting closed mouth. There is tension between love and wanting his waiting to mean something, but NO stock tragic-father worried eyebrows, tears or theatrical despair. No smile indicating reconciliation has happened.
Clothing: preserve plain worn dark warm-brown collarless coat and muted moss-green round-neck tunic from reference 1, only a narrow strip at the bottom. At most a small dull cord join, no broad chest, no modern lapels. Mismatched coat buttons, clean pocket cloth, old shoe and receipt fragment are outside this tight face crop and MUST NOT be floated beside the face. No hat on the head.
Distinctive silhouette: complete broad swept silver-gray hair, a relatively leaner mid-fifties face, less bulky jaw/beard than Buran. Keep the silver from becoming pure white.
